Chapter 685 - 685 Abyss; Bug Queen!

Chapter 685 - 685 Abyss; Bug Queen!

685 Abyss; Bug Queen!

The Qing Hall occupied an extremely wide area.

There were mountains, rivers, green trees, flowers… The scenery was beautiful and charming.

At this moment, Lin Fan and Qing Song had arrived at the grand hall. They were drinking Spirit Tea and chatting non-stop.

From the casual chat, Lin Fan gained a deeper understanding of the Four Seasons Universe and the levels of cultivators.

The cultivation levels were—Kill Ten, Annihilate 100, Enemy 1,000, Transcendent, Soul Formation, and above that was the Planet level.

The Planet level could be further divided into nine levels.

At this moment, Qing Song said, “Although it’s a little presumptuous, I wonder if you can help me?”

“Oh?” Lin Fan was puzzled.

Qing Song said, “A Mystic Abyss Realm has appeared on our Qing Planet. Every once in a while, a group of mutated beasts at the levels of Kill Ten, Annihilate 100, and even Enemy 1,000 will come out. Although they’re weak, they’re also very troublesome.

“Therefore, I want to enter the Mystic Abyss Realm and solve this hidden danger in one fell swoop.

“However, I don’t know what’s there in the realm. There might be some treasures and some dangers. Therefore, I’ve also invited Star Lord Feng Yue of the Spirit Planet and Star Lord Ma Zheng of the Hong Planet to go together.

“If there are any treasures, we’ll distribute them according to contribution. In addition, I’ll give you another ten spirit crystals as a reward.

“I wonder if you’re interested?”

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

This was definitely an opportunity for him to gain a deeper understanding of the Chaosverse.

“Sure.” He nodded.

Perhaps there was some danger in the secret realm.

However, danger was sometimes an opportunity.

This was something he had to face on the road to becoming stronger.

“That’s great!” Qing Song said happily. “With you joining us, we’ll have a greater chance of resolving the crisis in the Mystic Abyss Realm.”

At this moment, two streaks of light shot over from afar.

Then, an oval-faced woman in a purple muslin dress and a man with a long sword hanging from his waist appeared in the hall.

“Feng Yue, Ma Zheng, you’re here!” Qing Song laughed heartily.

Then, he introduced, “This is Lin Fan.”

Feng Yue and Ma Zheng could not help but size Lin Fan up curiously.

“Should we rest for a while or go straight to the Mystic Abyss Realm?” Qing Song asked.

“Let’s go over directly,” Ma Zheng said.

Feng Yue nodded.

Lin Fan said, “I’ve already rested.”

“Alright! Then let’s go over,” Qing Song said.

As soon as he finished speaking, he leaped and flew out.

Lin Fan, Feng Yue, and Ma Zheng followed closely behind.

In the beginning, Feng Yue and Ma Zheng underestimated Lin Fan.

However, looking at how relaxed Lin Fan was as he flew, they quickly threw this thought to the back of their minds.

A moment later, they stopped.

In front of them was a huge crack that looked like a black hole. It was extremely terrifying.

Two soldiers ran over and said respectfully, “Greetings, Star Lord!”

“When did the mutated beasts last come out?” Qing Song asked.

“Three days ago,” the soldier said.

“I understand,” Qing Song said.

“Do you guys see anything?” he asked.

Feng Yue shook her head. “We can’t see anything from the outside. We have to go in.”

“Let’s go in,” Ma Zheng said.

Lin Fan nodded as well.

“Alright,” Qing Song said.

The four of them took a step forward and flew into the abyss.

After entering the abyss, a cold aura assaulted their faces.

At this moment, a huge bird that was dozens of meters long stretched out its sharp claws and whistled toward them, as if it wanted to tear them into pieces.

Qing Song raised his hand and waved, shooting out a sharp gust of wind that instantly cut it in half.

Following the death of the giant bird, more exotic beasts appeared one after another.

However, without any surprises, they were all easily dealt with by Qing Song. The four of them together were unstoppable.

A few hours later, Lin Fan, Qing Song, Feng Yue and Ma Zheng finally landed at the bottom of the abyss.

It was dark here. The ground was very rugged, and there were holes everywhere.

Lin Fan looked around curiously.

It was his first time entering the abyss.

The ground not far away suddenly shook.

In the next moment, a large group of exotic beasts quickly rushed over.

The four of them attacked together and dealt with all the mutated beasts easily.

The rugged ground was immediately dyed red.

The four of them moved forward.

Along the way, they encountered a few more groups of exotic beasts.

“Why do these mutated beasts feel a little strange?” Ma Zheng frowned.

Feng Yue said, “It is a little strange. It’s like they’re running away. Is there something in front?”

Qing Song said, “I have a bad feeling. There might be some danger ahead. You guys have to be careful.”

The few of them nodded and became even more careful.

At this moment, a vast and mysterious energy surged over from afar.

The four of them looked up, and their pupils constricted slightly.

Dense golden bugs were moving in unison, surrounding the ancient altar and making rustling sounds.

“Chaos Locusts!”

“Why are there Chaos Locusts here?”

“There are spirit crystals around the altar! This is bad! It’s the altar of the Bug Queen!”

“We must not let the Bug Queen be teleported out. Otherwise, Qing Planet and even the surrounding planets will all become nourishment for the Bug Queen!”

“Hurry!”

At this moment, they finally understood why the exotic beast had run out of the abyss.

That was because the mutated beasts were also afraid of the Chaos Locusts, and they were even more afraid of the Bug Queen!

The four of them dashed forward, trying to destroy the altar as fast as they could.

Their movements quickly attracted the attention of the Chaos Locusts.

Four Chaos Locusts that were dozens of meters tall and covered in golden armor blocked their path.

“They’re Chaos Locust Generals!” Ma Zheng said solemnly. “Star Traveller, everyone, be careful!”

The four Chaos Locust Generals waved their claws and slashed at Lin Fan and the rest.

They were swift and tyrannical!

Lin Fan and the others took out their weapons to block, creating a series of rapid collisions.

Then, a few balls of light flashed in the air. Energy surged, and a series of loud sounds continuously sounded.

These four Chaos Locusts were all at the Star Traveller level. They could not be dealt with in a short period of time.

The only thing that Lin Fan could do was to use the mysterious space technique to leave some wounds on the Chaos Locusts.

At this moment, the spirit crystals around the ancient altar suddenly emitted a dazzling light.

Circles of mysterious formation talismans rippled in all directions.

Then, a huge door appeared above the altar.

Seeing this…

The Chaos Locusts around the altar moved up and down as if they were kowtowing.

The rustling sounds from their mouths became louder and louder.

In the next moment, a crack appeared on the door, and there were faint signs of it opening.

Qing Song cried out in shock, “Lin Fan, you have a spatial technique, so you’re the fastest. Quickly stop the Bug Queen from descending. I’ll help you with the Chaos Locust Generals!”

Lin Fan did not argue and said directly, “Aright!”
